observations: body L9-L23: the Arabic text of al-Kharaqī's chapter is set right to left in a larger type, its lines justified across the measure, the first line indented on the right; the note numbers 1 to 4 are raised Latin figures after the words they concern, and an asterisk stands before the corrupt words of L19. The edition sets the lines in the Amiri type at the measured leading of the block.

body L9: the head «الباب الثاني» stands between two ornaments, each a crescent with a rosette; they are given as the ornate parentheses ﴿ ﴾. The kāf of «المساكن» is printed in its wide form, with a long upper stroke.
body L9: «الجَيْهانيُّ» carries a fatha over the jīm, a sukūn over the yā', and a shadda with a damma over the last letter.
body L13: between «ذلك» and «ثمانية» a black mark like an exclamation mark crosses the line; it is a raised spacing piece, not a sign.
body L14, L18: the shadda over the last letters of «البربريّ» and «الفارسيّ» is printed as a small blot.
body L19: the corrupt words «وٮحاله ى حٮه» are printed without the dots of their teeth, as in manuscript P (note 4).
body L22: specks stand over the alif of «ارض» and under «اقصى»; they are not signs.
body L24: the readings of the manuscripts stand under a short rule in the type of the notes; the last reading, «وٮحالهِ ى خنبه», keeps the undotted tooth and carries a kasra under the hā'.
body L1: the quotation of al-Kharaqī, begun on p. 169, ends here.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
